system.description:
Altina stands in the center of the training field as her teammates circle her. “You sure we should be all attacking you simultaneously?” one asks while looking concerned as he gets into position. “Yeah, for the last time, I need to master this combination. Now do it!” Altina responds irritated. Her 2 allies sigh as they redirect their trajectory and assault her with two different jutsu from two opposing sides. She quickly leaps into the air dodging them both while weaving hand seals and firing multiple motes of Lightning at both her allies as she quickly weaves a second jutsu together firing jets of Water into the motes of Lightning as they combine and beam towards her training partners...

—Tatsunami Aburame

The Long Road, Ch. 4 excerpt.

Bound by A Code of Honor

The Sarutobi Clan is an influential clan from Konoha. It has produced several renowned members who have held positions of high authority, including the Third Hokage; whose son, Asuma, held membership in the Twelve Guardian Ninja, while his other children served directly under the Hokage along with their spouse as Anbu. All known members have also been devout observers of the Will of Fire. This clan has the strength and influence to tie other clans together and create long lasting bonds.

Sarutobi Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Str or Int, +1 Con

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Pick any two skills between: Ninshou, Martial Arts, Illusions

Advanced Nature Affinity: Select one Nature release between Earth, Wind, Fire, Water, Lightning or Medical. You are now able to add jutsu with the corresponding Keyword to your jutsu list. (Suggestion: Fire Release)

The Will of Fire: You gain a Will of Fire when you complete a long rest if you didn’t already have one.

Sarutobi Features

The Legacy of The Past

1st Level Clan Feature

As a Sarutobi, you have inherited the Will of Fire from your forefathers. You embody it more than most other clans in your given village. You’ve been taught that focus and determination is what makes a shinobi strong. This Will is pooled within you, available to be called upon at a moment’s notice. Starting from character creation, you have a number of Will equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus.

You can spend Will on Legacy Techniques and other features that call for it. You regain spent Will when you complete a rest. You gain 2 Legacy Technique at character creation, and an additional one at 7th and 15th levels.

Kindled Will

By spending 1 Will you gain a rank of Mastery to your next d20 based roll. Beginning at 7th level, if you spend 3 Will, you can instead gain two ranks of Mastery. Beginning at 15th level, if you spend 5 Will you gain three ranks of Mastery.

Swift Reaction

Once per turn, by spending 3 Will you gain an additional reaction, which you lose at the end of the current turn if not used. For every additional use beyond the first, increase the Will cost by +1, until you complete a short rest. You cannot have more than one additional reaction per round as a result of this technique.

Aggressive Response

Once per turn, by spending 2 Will you can spend your reaction to cast a jutsu or use a feature with a cost of 1 Action.

Determination

At the beginning of your turn where you need to make a Death saving throw. Before rolling, you can spend 2 Will. When you do, you immediately gain a success before rolling.

Inspiring Will

When an allied creature other than yourself would make a d20 Roll, you can spend 2 Will to grant them a rank of Mastery to their result. Beginning at 7th level, if you spend 4 Will, they can instead gain two ranks of Mastery. Beginning at 15th level, if you spend 6 Will, they gain three ranks of Mastery.

Enduring

When you or an allied creature fail a saving throw, you can spend 2 Will and a reaction to remake the saving throw.

Limit Break

As part of casting a jutsu you know with a casting time of 1 Action, you can spend 3 Will to cast the jutsu again, targeting a different creature as part of the same action at no additional chakra cost.

Second Wind

As a bonus action, you dig deep pulling out a reserve of energy and stamina from your ancestors. Spend any number of Will up to your remaining. For the first Will spent, you roll a die the same size as either your Hit or chakra die. You regain hit or chakra points based on the die rolled equal to the result + your constitution modifier. For every Will spent after the first, roll 1d6, adding it to the result. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until 10 minutes have passed. You cannot use this feature unless you are in combat.

Blessing of the Flame

1st Level Clan Feature

Sarutobi are trained and skilled in a variety of tools and weapons and you are no different. When you take a long rest, you can perform a family ritual, calling on the blessings of the will of fire to grant you the mastery needed to use these tools of war to maintain the fires of will.

Select one Weapon Group or one Weapon Property. All weapons part of the chosen group or that share the chosen property that you wield become Flame Blessed until you complete a long rest. Weapons that are Flame Blessed gain the following benefits:

You cannot be disarmed of Flame Blessed weapons unless you are incapacitated.

Weapon attacks with Flame Blessed weapons can use your Taijutsu, Ninjutsu or Genjutsu ability modifier.

You gain a rank of Mastery to [Weapon Damage] (or [Unarmed Damage] if a Flame Blessed weapon with the Unarmed property) that you deal.

Cross-Style

3rd Level Clan Feature

As a Sarutobi, you are a versatile Swiss army knife of skill and options. You are able to mix it up and use any form of combat you see fit to unlike all others.

This technique manifests itself into a unique stance known as Cross-Style. This stance is unique in that it counts as a Chakra, Taijutsu and Bukijutsu stance all at once. You can enter your Cross-Style stance as a bonus action. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits.

Chakra Powered Strikes. Your unarmed damage die becomes 1d6. Your [Unarmed Damage] and [Weapon Damage] types becomes the damage type associated with the nature release you selected for Advanced Nature Affinity (Medical = Poison).

Unified Form. Once per turn, when you cast a Jutsu (Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu) as an Action, you can spend a number of Will based on the jutsu’s rank (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5) to cast a second jutsu of a different discipline but the same rank as part of the same action. The second jutsu must have the same casting time and neither jutsu can require concentration or benefit from cost reduction effects. Once you do, you cannot spend your Bonus action to cast a jutsu until the beginning of your next turn. You gain a benefit based on the order in which you cast the chosen jutsu:

Any > Ninjutsu: Affected creatures with ranks of a Physical, Elemental, or Sensory condition suffer a -1 to their saving throw against the Ninjutsu cast.

Any > Taijutsu: The initial jutsu cast gains the Combo keyword and when the Taijutsu deals damage, the affected creature is pushed 10 feet in a direction of your choice.

Any > Bukijutsu: The initial jutsu cast gains the Chain keyword and when the Bukijutsu deals damage, the affected creature has a -1 to their AC until the beginning of your next turn.

Any > Genjutsu: Select a willing allied creature within half your movement speed range. You each teleport and swap places with each other.

Ember’s Guardian

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your clan is one that has been charged with the protection of the wills of the people. The will of fire. This takes the form in ways of protecting your allies should they find themselves in dire straits.

Guardians Will. When an allied creature within 10 feet of you takes damage from an attack, you can spend your reaction to swap spaces with them. The attack now hits you. As part of this attack dealing damage to you, you reduce the damage you take by an amount equal to your [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage].

Bonded Resolve. When an allied creature would take damage while within 10 feet of you, you can spend your reaction to interpose and share some of the impact, shouldering the weight of your team. Reduce the damage your allied creature would take by half. You take damage equal to the reduced damage of the same type.

| #### Blazing / Battle Amp / Your Will Surges. / Kindling. At the beginning of each of your turns, you regain 1 Will. / Apotheosis. Reduce the Will cost for Unified Form by 1. / Blazing Limits. You gain a +1 to Weapon and Taijutsu attacks with Flame Blessed weapons. |

Advanced Release Manifestation

7th Level Clan Feature

The Sarutobi clan has a unique talent for manifesting multiple different nature releases, focusing in on a core martial fighting technique or broadening their illusory skills. You have reached that decision point. Select one:

You gain another Nature release you didn’t select from your Advanced Nature Affinity clan trait.

Select a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu Expert stance, even if you don’t qualify. You gain the benefits of the chosen Expert stance while in your Cross-Style stance.

While in your Cross-Style stance, creatures that critically succeed a saving throw against a Genjutsu you cast, suffer the effects of a success if you spend 2 Will.

Inspiring Presence

7th Level Clan Feature

Even when all seems lost, and there doesn’t seem to be any more hope. You and your clans presence is more than enough to instill the thought that there is a way forward. Creatures of your choice that begin their turn within 10 feet of you, reduce ranks of Demoralized and Shaken they have by -1.

Rekindling Pulse

11th Level Clan Feature

An ally falls and you refuse to let them stay there. You keep their flame alive with but a glance and bellowing command to survive.

As an Action, all allied creatures you can see within 20 feet of you, who are Incapacitated, Stunned, Dying or Unconscious makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. You can spend any number of Will as part of this action. For every Will spent, all affected creatures gain a +1 bonus to this saving throw. On a successful save:

If they had 0 hit points, they immediately spend all remaining hit die, regaining the result and gain ranks of Exhaustion equal to half the spent hit die.

If they had hit points, they lose all of the listed conditions, and stand from prone.

Creatures cannot be affected by this feature more than once per long rest.

Will of Fire Incarnate

15th Level Clan Feature

You embody the will of fire unlike anyone else. Your clan has taught you what the will of fire means, but you practice and preach of it like a religion, primary or secondary.

As a bonus action, you can ignite the Will of Fire within you for the next minute. For the duration, you Will Blazes. Once you cause your Will to blaze, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.
